card.line: Riblah was an ancient city in the land of Hamath, where foreign kings made their base and passed judgment on the last kings and leaders of Judah.

moments.title: Jehoahaz Imprisoned
moments.text: Pharaoh Neco locked up Jehoahaz at Riblah so he could not rule in Jerusalem. Neco also made Judah pay a levy of silver and gold.

moments.title: Zedekiah Judged
moments.text: The Chaldeans caught King Zedekiah and brought him to the king of Babylon at Riblah, where judgment was pronounced on him. His sons were killed before his eyes, and then he was blinded and taken to Babylon in shackles.

moments.title: Leaders Put to Death
moments.text: Nebuzaradan brought the priests, officials, and other men taken from Jerusalem to the king of Babylon at Riblah. There the king put them to death, and Judah was taken into exile.
